title: Hungjao Sanitarium - Taken Over By Japanese Military

page_data.en:
CTH
FM
G. 90M-1

CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section I, Special Branch. /Addl/ 39
REPORT
File No. 9599C
Date December 15, 39.

Subject Hungjao Sanitarium - taken over by Japanese military.

Made by D. S. I. MacAdie. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

The Hungjao Sanitarium, No.310 Hungjao Road
was established by and is the property of Dr. Ting Wei
Kong (丁惠康).

After the outbreak of hostilities the
Sanitarium was removed to its present address, 990-992
Avenue Foch while the house on Hungjao Road was leased
to an Italian Doctor named Muto-Nardone. The lease
was ante-dated so as to appear to have been concluded
before hostilities and the monthly rental was set at
$900.00 but as far as can be ascertained no rent was
ever paid. Dr. Muto-Nardone never occupied the
premises but flew the Italian flag from the house, so
that after the withdrawal of the Chinses troops, the
Japanese did not occupy the place. Some five months
ago the Russian Orthodox Confraternity successfully
negotiated with Dr. Muto-Nardone to take over the
Sanitarium as a mental Hospital. However, as the
Japanese Military would not agree to the removal of
patients to the Sanitarium the scheme fell through.

About three months ago, Dr. Muto-Nardone
left Shanghai for Switzerland owing to the sickness
of his children and before leaving turned over the
lease of the Sanitarium to the Italian Consulate
General. The officials of the Consulate recently
broached the matter to certain Japanese military officials

（左侧批注框内手写签名：Jhn Robertson）

（左侧椭圆印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 16 DEC. 1939）

特科第一股 /增补/ 39
报告
档案号 9599C
日期 1939年12月15日。

主题：虹桥疗养院——被日军接管。

撰写人：D. S. I. MacAdie。转呈人：D. I. Crawford。

虹桥疗养院位于虹桥路310号，
由丁惠康医生（Dr. Ting Wei Kong）创办并为其所有。

战事爆发后，
该疗养院迁至现址福煦路990-992号，而虹桥路的房屋则出租给一位名为穆托-纳尔多内（Muto-Nardone）的意大利医生。租约日期被倒签，以显示在战事爆发前已订立，月租金定为900.00美元，但据查，从未支付过任何租金。穆托-纳尔多内医生从未入住该处，只是在房屋上悬挂意大利国旗，因此在中国军队撤退后，日军并未占领该地。大约五个月前，俄罗斯东正教兄弟会成功与穆托-纳尔多内医生协商，拟接管该疗养院作为精神病院。然而，由于日本军方不同意将病人转移至该疗养院，该计划未能实现。

大约三个月前，穆托-纳尔多内医生因子女患病离开上海前往瑞士，并在离沪前将疗养院的租约移交给意大利总领事馆。领事馆官员最近向某些日本军方官员提及此事

（左侧批注框内手写签名：Jhn Robertson）

（左侧椭圆印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1939年12月16日）

（左下角模糊印记：档案）

Shun Poo, Ta Mei Pao, Hwa Pao, Sin Wan Pao and Chinese-
American Daily News :- 12.12.39 (AM)

JAPANESE TROOPS TAKE OVER HUNGJAO SANITARIUM

The Hungjao Sanitarium is located at No. 310
Hungjlo Road, Western District. It occupies a large area
and has remained unused since the outbreak of hostilities
on August 13, 1937, with only an Italian flag flying at
the top of the building. Recently, it was occupied by the
Japanese soldiers who have since put up several wooden
sheds on a piece of vacant ground at the east side of the
sanitarium. All the graves in the vicinity of the
hospital have been smoothed over and the place has been
closed by barbed wire fences. It is believed that these
sheds were constructed for the storage of munitions or
for the accommodation of vehicles.

Much speculation is prevalent as to the
cause of the Japanese occupation of this sanitarium.
One report says that the building will be converted into
a Japanese military hospital, while another states that
it will be used as the barracks for the puppet policemen.
No confirmation of either of these two reports is,
however, available, nor is it known as to whether the
building was taken over by the Japanese soldiers through
a lease or purchase from the proprietor or whether it
was forcibly occupied by them.

It will be remembered that the Russian
Orthodox Confraternity which has two hospitals, one on
Route de Say Zoong and another in Route Maresca, French
Concession, the latter being a mental ward, has been
endeavouring to secure the lease of the premises of the
Hungjao Sanitarium owing to lack of accommodation in its
mental ward. Unexpectedly, while negotiations to this
effect were going on, the building was occupied by the
Japanese soldiers, thereby completely preventing the plan
of the Russian institution from realization.

《顺报》、《大美报》、《华报》、《新晚报》及《中美日报》：1939年12月12日（上午）

日军接管虹桥疗养院

虹桥疗养院位于西区虹桥路310号。该院占地面积广阔，自1937年8月13日战事爆发以来一直闲置未用，仅在楼顶悬挂一面意大利国旗。近日，该处被日本士兵占领，随后在疗养院东侧的一块空地上搭建了几座木棚。医院附近的所有坟墓均被夷平，该区域已被铁丝网围栏封闭。据信，这些木棚是用于储存弹药或停放车辆。

关于日军占领该疗养院的原因，众说纷纭。一种说法称，该建筑将被改建为日军医院；另一种说法则称，将用作伪警察的营房。然而，这两种说法均未得到证实，也不清楚日军是通过从业主处租赁或购买而接管该建筑，还是强行占领。

值得一提的是，俄罗斯东正教兄弟会在法租界拥有两家医院，一家位于赛仲路（Route de Say Zoong），另一家位于马思南路（Route Maresca），后者设有精神病病房。由于精神病病房床位不足，该机构一直努力争取租用虹桥疗养院的处所。出乎意料的是，就在进行此类谈判期间，该建筑被日本士兵占领，从而彻底阻碍了该俄罗斯机构计划的实现。
